review.summary: Fix for tokenization crash/error when encountering invalid UTF-8 characters. Three functions (dotop1, isopsuffix, is_operator_start_char) would attempt to convert a malformed Char to UInt32, which throws an error. The fix adds early-return guards for malformed characters, consistent with existing guards for EOF_CHAR.
review.evidence: The commit subject explicitly states 'Fixes for tokenization of invalid UTF-8 strings (#155)'. The test file adds three corresponding test cases verifying these functions return false for malformed input. The pattern mirrors existing EOF_CHAR guards already present in each function.
